meta.description: Pull pre-computed ortholog calls from OrthoDB, Ensembl Compara, OMA, KEGG Orthology and documented PANTHER/eggNOG routes through a small Python requests client, with guidance on confidence semantics and when to defect to de novo inference.

scientific_integrity.detail: Live values match the services: TP53 mouse ENSMUSG00000059552 / P53_MOUSE / Trp53, MARCHF1 ENSG00000145416, KEGG K04451 with 548 members. No fabricated confidence values remain.

practice_boundaries.detail: Database retrieval only; no diagnostic or prescriptive output.

methodological_ground.detail: Resource semantics are not conflated; OrthoDB group verification and 1:1 filtering are sound.

code_usability.detail: All three examples ran to exit 0 on the final bytes; shortcomings are display and doc accuracy, filed as P2.

functional_suitability.note: Compara, OrthoDB, OMA and KEGG helpers return correct live values; one documented Compara route (/homology/id without species) is wrong and the batch example hides failed symbols.

reliability.note: One retry helper with timeout, 429/5xx handling and RequestException on exhaustion reproduced on a local stub and live; batch_compara records errors but the example does not display them.

performance_context.note: SKILL.md is about 190 lines; the decision matrix, per-resource reference and common-errors table partly repeat each other.

agent_usability.note: Decision matrix, OrthoDB full-text trap and group verification are clear; one wrong route in the Compara section and silent batch gaps in the example.

human_usability.note: Clear tables; eggNOG note says redirect to eggnogdb.org but eggnog6.embl.de now fails TLS verification (still labelled unverified).

security.note: No credentials, HTTPS (stub test used loopback only); read-only public APIs.

maintainability.note: Single client module; no automated tests, which is how the batch-display and route gaps survived.

agent_specific.note: Specific trigger description, clear defection to de novo tools; PANTHER and eggNOG are documented but not wrapped.

inputs.label: Ensembl Compara single gene, MARCH1 rename, five-gene zebrafish batch (compara_orthologs.py, final bytes)
inputs.note: Exit 0 on the first attempt on the final bytes. The batch table is correct for what returned but silently omits MDM2 (read timeout) and BRCA1 (no rows).

assertions.text: BRCA1 human to mouse returns ortholog_one2one ENSMUSG00000017146 with level and identity
MARCH1 returns HTTP 400 and the example reports the rename; MARCHF1 resolves to ENSG00000145416
TP53 and ATM zebrafish 1:1 calls are correct
Rows carry taxonomy_level and no confidence value
assertions.note: confidence None in every row; docs and example say so.

assertions.text: The example output surfaces batch symbols that failed or returned nothing
assertions.note: batch_compara put MDM2 in an error column (read timeout) and BRCA1 returned no rows; the example prints neither and reports 1:1 calls: 2 as if complete.

inputs.label: Cross-resource TP53: Compara, OMA 1:1, OrthoDB verified group (cross_resource.py)
inputs.note: All three legs returned and agree on mouse Trp53 / P53_MOUSE / ENSMUSG00000059552.

assertions.text: Compara TP53 human to mouse returns ENSMUSG00000059552
OMA TP53 P04637 rel_type=1:1 contains P53_MOUSE
OrthoDB leg selects the exact-name group and verifies the human member
The TIGAR-ranked first hit for query TP53 is rejected
assertions.note: orthodb_group_has_gene False for both top groups.

assertions.text: Each leg is isolated so one outage cannot abort the others
assertions.note: run() wrapper per leg; client raises RequestException on exhausted retries (stub test); live legs all succeeded.

inputs.label: KEGG Orthology gene to KO to members (kegg_orthology.py)

assertions.text: hsa:7157 maps to K04451
KO record lists TP53 and pathway entries
assertions.note: ENTRY K04451, SYMBOL TP53, P53; p53 signaling pathway present.

assertions.text: Member count and species count are consistent
Output is TSV-parsed plain text, not JSON

inputs.label: Client retry, timeout and parser guards (local HTTP stub, OrthoDB null data)
inputs.note: get_with_retry and the OrthoDB parser behave as documented.

assertions.text: 503, 503 then 200 succeeds on the third attempt
429 with Retry-After is retried
Persistent 500 raises RequestException after max_retries; unreachable host raises RequestException
assertions.note: 4 stub hits then RequestException; refused connection raised.

assertions.text: 404 raises HTTPError unless allow_404=True
orthodb_orthologs returns [] for a group with no member at the level and Trp53 for the p53 group at mouse
assertions.note: Yeast level returned []; mouse returned 22059 and Trp53.

inputs.label: Documented routes and claims: OrthoDB search and tab, PANTHER, OMA empty, HomoloGene, Compara homology/id, eggNOG
inputs.note: All corrected claims reproduce except the documented Compara /homology/id route.

assertions.text: OrthoDB /search is full text: TP53 ranks phosphoglycerate mutase first, tumor protein p53 reaches 4289813at2759
OrthoDB /tab uses id= (TSV) and query= returns 404
PANTHER matchortho P04637 returns mouse Tp53 with ortholog type LDO
OMA BRCA1 P38398 returns an empty 200 and the HOG route resolves for P04637
HomoloGene efetch is retired
assertions.note: efetch db=homologene returns an error body.

assertions.text: SKILL.md route /homology/id/<ensembl_gene_id> works as written
assertions.note: 404 (page not found) without the species segment on two independent clients; /homology/id/human/<id> returns 200.

key_strengths: The eight initial findings are fixed: null-safe OrthoDB parser, one retrying client, no phantom confidence, verified OrthoDB group selection, isolated cross-resource legs, corrected /tab and PANTHER notes, licence.
Retry and error behaviour was reproduced independently on a local stub (503 then 200, 429 Retry-After, persistent 500, 404, refused connection).
Compara, OMA, OrthoDB and KEGG all returned scientifically consistent TP53 calls in the cross-resource example.

recommendations.title: OI-09 SKILL.md homology/id route needs a species
recommendations.problem: The Compara section lists /homology/id/<ensembl_gene_id>, which returns 404; the working route is /homology/id/<species>/<id>.
recommendations.root_cause: Route copied without a live check; the sibling ensembl-rest Skill fixed the same row.

recommendations.title: OI-10 Batch example hides failed and empty symbols
recommendations.problem: compara_orthologs.py prints only the 1:1 rows and a count; MDM2 (read timeout, in the error column) and BRCA1 (no rows) are invisible, so 1:1 calls: 2 reads as a complete answer for five genes.
recommendations.root_cause: The example never prints the error column or the symbols without calls that batch_compara returns.
recommendations.fix: Print symbols with an error (with the message) and symbols with no rows after the table.

recommendations.title: eggNOG redirect note is stale
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md says eggnog6.embl.de/api redirects to eggnogdb.org/api; today the old host fails TLS verification and eggnogdb.org/api returns 403.
recommendations.root_cause: Service moved after the note was written.
recommendations.fix: State both failure modes or only that scripted access is refused.
